_comment: macOS builds whose AMDRadeonVADriver2 was validated. Installing on an UNLISTED build is blocked by default (GPU-hang risk) and needs the explicit override in the app. Add a build only after checking its driver: the same driverUUID as a listed build means the same binary (tools/dscdiff.py info); a new UUID needs the decode path compared first. av1/vp9: true = decoded bit-exact on a GPU, "untested-on-gpu" = driver validated but not run yet, false = the plug-in refuses this driver and macOS falls back to software.
